verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a drag-and-drop visual editor, code editor, Design Studio for drafting emails, reusable Assets library, and AI-generated global styles, supporting on-brand template design. However, there is no concrete evidence about personalization token rendering fidelity across email clients or dedicated cross-client testing/preview beyond inbox preview credits, and no independent hands-on review of the editor's usability. Missing for 10: cross-client rendering verification/testing evidence, personalization token documentation detail, independent reviews of visual editor quality.
